records.name: Talian HEAL 15555 (mental health crisis line)
records.what: The national mental health crisis line, run by counselling officers of the Ministry of Health (KKM). It gives emotional support and early help in a crisis, including thoughts of suicide, depression, anxiety, panic and stress.
records.who: Anyone in Malaysia. Help is given in English, Malay and Tamil.
records.start: Call 15555, any day from 8 am to midnight, public holidays included. In immediate danger, call 999.

records.name: JAKOA, Department of Orang Asli Development (Jabatan Kemajuan Orang Asli)
records.what: The federal department responsible for Orang Asli development on Peninsular Malaysia, including education, economic and community programmes in Orang Asli villages.
records.who: Orang Asli people and villages on Peninsular Malaysia.
records.start: Call the head office in Putrajaya, or contact your state JAKOA office, and ask which programme fits your need.
records.address: Aras 10, Blok A, Bangunan Suasana PjH, Presint 2, Putrajaya
